name: axium
description: AXIUM — Sistema Comercial Integrado (CRM + Agenda + Rotina + Tarefas + Arquivos)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @axium/api & npm run dev -w @axium/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @axium/shared && npm run build -w @axium/api && npm run build -w @axium/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @axium/api && npm run lint -w @axium/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @axium/api && npm run test -w @axium/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build

comments.overrides: multer 2.4.0 corrige o 2.0.2 fixado por @nestjs/platform-express 10.x (CVE). O lockfile ja fixa multer 2.4.0, entao `npm ci` instala a versao corrigida em npm >=10 (verificado com npm 10.9 e 11.12).
